items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I heard him play a solo. He played now and then, not bad.

ctx.x: associate of --, a business partner -- I'm mixing French and everything else -- a business partner at the Stage B -- MR. COLLIER: Which was? MR. BRIGGS: A cabaret in Montparnasse, on Boulevard Montparnasse. On the Left Bank. I -- in order to form the orchestra, I engaged Django Reinhardt, George Marion on drums, Alix Combelle on tenor-sax -- he was only learning the saxophone at the time -- and Stephane Grapelly on piano-violin. Well, it so happened that in order for us to get a rest in the evening, especially…
